blocks.html: If an application is submitted for a permit for the construction of foundations or any other part of a building before the construction documents for the whole building have been submitted, then the geotechnical peer review and report shall be phased. The geotechnical peer reviewer shall be provided with sufficient information on which to make a geotechnical peer review of the phased submission. In addition to the requirements of this section, phased submission of the report shall include any changes made to the initial geotechnical peer review evaluation. The geotechnical peer review report need not be submitted concurrently with the structural peer review report.
